Councilmember Doan has called District 7 home for over 40 years and has spent his life serving our community as a firefighter and now as your City Councilmember.
From cleaner neighborhoods to improved public safety, Bien puts you first by focusing on the results we all can see and feel. He’s working every day to make District 7 a safer, better place for all of us.
## MEET BIEN DOAN
Proven Leadership for a Safer,
Cleaner San José
Mayor Matt Mahan endorsed my re-election, saying I am the experienced leader we need to guide us through tough fiscal times while prioritizing public safety, cleaner neighborhoods, and better city services.
​
As your Councilmember and a 22-year San José Fire Captain, I have focused on public safety, housing affordability, and lowering the cost of living while restoring parks like our Japanese Friendship Garden, Vietnamese Heritage Garden, and Tully Ballfields.
​
I led efforts to address homelessness through cost-effective shelter solutions and addressed problematic RVs. I demanded accountability for $300 million in untracked homelessness spending, protected taxpayer dollars, strengthened neighborhood services, supported responsible housing growth, protected renters, and fought to keep mobile homes affordable. Our work is not finished.
As an immigrant and a father, I believe in hard work and delivering real results. Families should be able to afford the homes they love.
​
I am the only candidate in recent history endorsed by both the South Bay Labor Council and the Silicon Valley Biz PAC. I am also endorsed by GSMOL mobile homeowners, Police Officers, San José Firefighters Local 230, District Attorney Jeff Rosen, Congressman Sam Liccardo, and many community leaders.
​
I’d be honored to earn your vote again.

# Endorsements That Reflect Results
Councilmember Bien Doan has earned something rare in today’s political climate: broad support from both business and labor leaders, along with neighborhood communities like our mobilehome residents. These endorsements matter because they come from people who often see issues from very different perspectives, yet have come to the same conclusion.
​
They recognize Bien as a proven, results-driven leader who understands how to bring people together to solve real problems. From supporting working families and protecting residents, to strengthening small businesses and improving public safety, Bien has demonstrated the ability to balance priorities and deliver successful outcomes.
​
“Bien Doan is the experienced leader we need to guide San José through tough fiscal times while prioritizing public safety, cleaner neighborhoods, and better city services.”
— Matt Mahan,
Mayor of San José

"I am proud to endorse Bien Doan for San José City Council. Throughout his career in public service, Bien has demonstrated integrity, strong leadership, and a deep commitment to the safety and well-being of our community.
I have seen firsthand the importance of having leaders who understand the critical role that public safety plays in maintaining a strong and resilient city. Bien Doan brings that understanding, along with a thoughtful and collaborative approach to problem-solving. He listens, he engages, and he works tirelessly to ensure that the voices of residents are heard.
Bien’s dedication to improving neighborhoods, supporting first responders, and strengthening community partnerships makes him exceptionally well-qualified to serve on the City Council. I am confident that he will continue to lead with professionalism, accountability, and a genuine passion for public service.
I strongly encourage the residents of San José to support Bien Doan for City Council."
— Reggie Williams
San José Fire Chief, Ret.
